slides.h:
Animals: Invertebrate and Vertebrate Groups · 1/11

Invertebrate phyla in a line无脊椎动物各门

Sponges, cnidarians, flatworms, roundworms, mollusks, annelids, arthropods and echinoderms are the main invertebrate phyla.海绵、刺胞动物、扁形动物、线虫、软体动物、环节动物、节肢动物和棘皮动物是主要的无脊椎动物门。

Animals: Invertebrate and Vertebrate Groups · 2/11

Sponges and cnidarians海绵与刺胞动物

Sponges are sessile and filter water through pores. Cnidarians have radial symmetry, tentacles with stinging cells and two forms: polyp and medusa.海绵固着，通过孔道滤水；刺胞动物辐射对称，触手有刺细胞，有水螅型和水母型两种体型。

Animals: Invertebrate and Vertebrate Groups · 3/11

Three kinds of worms三类蠕虫

Flatworms have no cavity. Roundworms have a partial cavity and a complete gut. Annelids are segmented with a true coelom.扁形动物没有体腔；线虫有假体腔和完整消化道；环节动物分节并有真体腔。

Animals: Invertebrate and Vertebrate Groups · 4/11

Mollusks软体动物

Soft body, a mantle that makes the shell, and a muscular foot. Many have a radula. Snails, clams and squid are mollusks.身体柔软，外套膜分泌外壳，有肌肉质足，许多有齿舌。蜗牛、蛤、鱿鱼都是软体动物。

Animals: Invertebrate and Vertebrate Groups · 5/11

Arthropods节肢动物

Jointed legs, segmented body and a chitin exoskeleton that must be molted. Insects, arachnids and crustaceans are the big groups.有分节的足、分节的身体和需要蜕去的几丁质外骨骼；昆虫、蛛形动物和甲壳动物是三大类群。

Animals: Invertebrate and Vertebrate Groups · 6/11

Insects, arachnids, crustaceans昆虫、蛛形与甲壳

Insects: 3 body parts, 6 legs. Arachnids: 2 body parts, 8 legs. Crustaceans: 2 pairs of antennae and usually gills.昆虫：三部分身体，六条腿；蛛形动物：两部分身体，八条腿；甲壳动物：两对触角，通常有鳃。

Animals: Invertebrate and Vertebrate Groups · 7/11

Metamorphosis变态

Complete: egg, larva, pupa, adult. Incomplete: egg, nymph, adult. The pupa is the stage that sets them apart.完全变态：卵、幼虫、蛹、成虫；不完全变态：卵、若虫、成虫；区别在于有没有蛹期。

Animals: Invertebrate and Vertebrate Groups · 8/11

Chordates脊索动物

At some stage chordates have a notochord, a dorsal hollow nerve cord, pharyngeal slits and a tail past the anus.脊索动物在某个阶段有脊索、背神经管、咽裂和肛后尾。

Animals: Invertebrate and Vertebrate Groups · 9/11

Five vertebrate classes五大类脊椎动物

Fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds and mammals. Fish, amphibians and reptiles are ectotherms. Birds and mammals are endotherms.鱼类、两栖类、爬行类、鸟类、哺乳类；鱼类、两栖类、爬行类是变温动物；鸟类和哺乳类是恒温动物。

Animals: Invertebrate and Vertebrate Groups · 10/11

Moving onto land走向陆地

Amphibians still need water to lay eggs. Reptiles evolved the amniotic egg with a shell, so they could reproduce away from water.两栖类仍需在水中产卵；爬行类演化出带壳的羊膜卵，因而可以远离水繁殖。

Animals: Invertebrate and Vertebrate Groups · 11/11

Three kinds of mammals三类哺乳动物

Monotremes lay eggs. Marsupials bear tiny young that grow in a pouch. Placental mammals nourish the embryo through a placenta.单孔类产卵；有袋类产下很小的幼体，在育儿袋中成长；有胎盘类通过胎盘养育胚胎。

cards.f: SPONGE
cards.b:
A sessile animal with a porous body and no true tissues. It filters food from water.

海绵动物：身体多孔、没有真正组织的固着动物，滤食水中的食物。

🧠 Phylum Porifera = pore-bearers.多孔动物门 Porifera = 带孔的。

Quick check: How does a sponge feed?

It filters tiny food particles from water that passes through its pores.

cards.f: cni·DAR·i·an
cards.b:
A radially symmetrical animal with tentacles that carry stinging cells, such as a jellyfish.

刺胞动物：辐射对称、触手上有刺细胞的动物，如水母。

🧠 knide = nettle (Greek). The c is silent: ny-DAIR-ee-an.knide = 荨麻；c 不发音。

Quick check: Name a cnidarian.

A jellyfish, sea anemone or coral.

cards.f: CNI·do·cyte
cards.b:
A stinging cell on a cnidarian's tentacles that fires a barbed thread at prey.

刺细胞：刺胞动物触手上的刺人细胞，会向猎物射出带倒刺的丝。

🧠 cnide = nettle, cyte = cell. Nettle cell.cnide = 荨麻，cyte = 细胞。

Quick check: What does a cnidocyte do?

It stings prey.

cards.f: POL·yp
cards.b:
A cnidarian body form that is tube-shaped and attached, with the mouth and tentacles pointing up.

水螅型：刺胞动物管状、固着的体型，口和触手朝上。

🧠 poly = many, pous = foot.poly = 多，pous = 足。

Quick check: Is a polyp sessile or motile?

Sessile (attached).

cards.f: me·DU·sa
cards.b:
A cnidarian body form that is bell-shaped and free-swimming, with the mouth pointing down.

水母型：刺胞动物钟形、自由游动的体型，口朝下。

🧠 named after Medusa, the Greek monster with snakes for hair.以希腊神话中长蛇发的美杜莎命名。

Quick check: Which body form is a jellyfish?

A medusa.

cards.f: FLAT·worm
cards.b:
A flat, soft-bodied, bilateral animal with no body cavity, such as a planarian or tapeworm.

扁形动物：身体扁平柔软、两侧对称、没有体腔的动物，如涡虫和绦虫。

🧠 platy = flat, helminth = worm.platy = 扁平，helminth = 蠕虫。

Quick check: Is a flatworm a coelomate?

No. It is an acoelomate.

cards.f: ROUND·worm
cards.b:
A cylindrical worm with a complete gut from mouth to anus, such as a nematode.

线虫（圆形动物）：圆柱形的蠕虫，有从口到肛门的完整消化道，如线虫。

🧠 nema = thread.nema = 线。

Quick check: Which animals are Nematoda?

Roundworms.

cards.f: MOL·lusk
cards.b:
A soft-bodied animal with a mantle and muscular foot, often shelled, such as a snail or clam.

软体动物：身体柔软、有外套膜和肌肉质足、通常有壳的动物，如蜗牛、蛤和鱿鱼。

🧠 mollis = soft.mollis = 软。

Quick check: Name a mollusk.

A snail, clam, octopus or squid.

cards.f: MAN·tle
cards.b:
The layer of tissue in a mollusk that covers the body and makes the shell.

外套膜：软体动物覆盖身体并分泌外壳的组织层。

🧠 mantle = cloak.mantle = 斗篷。

Quick check: What does the mantle make?

The shell.

cards.f: RAD·u·la
cards.b:
A tongue-like organ covered with tiny teeth that many mollusks use to scrape food.

齿舌：软体动物许多种类用来刮食食物的、布满小齿的舌状器官。

🧠 radula = scraper.radula = 刮刀。

Quick check: What is a radula used for?

Scraping food.

cards.f: AN·ne·lid
cards.b:
A segmented worm with a coelom and a closed circulatory system, such as an earthworm.

环节动物：身体分节、有真体腔和闭管式循环系统的蠕虫，如蚯蚓。

🧠 annulus = little ring.annulus = 小环。

Quick check: Name an annelid.

An earthworm or a leech.

cards.f: AR·thro·pod
cards.b:
An animal with jointed legs, a segmented body and a hard exoskeleton, such as an insect, spider or crab.

节肢动物：有分节的足、分节的身体和坚硬外骨骼的动物，如昆虫、蜘蛛和螃蟹。

🧠 arthro = joint, pod = foot. Jointed foot.arthro = 关节，pod = 足。

Quick check: What does arthropod mean?

Jointed foot.

cards.f: MOLT·ing
cards.b:
Shedding the old exoskeleton so the animal can grow.

蜕皮：脱去旧外骨骼以便继续生长。

🧠 molt = change.molt = 换。

Quick check: Why do arthropods molt?

Their hard exoskeleton cannot grow, so they shed it to get bigger.

cards.f: com·PLETE met·a·MOR·pho·sis
cards.b:
Development in four stages: egg, larva, pupa and adult, where the adult looks very different.

完全变态：经过卵、幼虫、蛹、成虫四个阶段的发育，成虫外形与幼虫差别很大。

🧠 meta = change, morphe = shape.meta = 改变，morphe = 形状。

Quick check: Name an insect with complete metamorphosis.

A butterfly, beetle or fly.

cards.f: in·com·PLETE met·a·MOR·pho·sis
cards.b:
Development in three stages: egg, nymph and adult, where the nymph looks like a small adult.

不完全变态：经过卵、若虫、成虫三个阶段的发育，若虫像小型成虫。

🧠 A nymph skips the pupa.若虫没有蛹期。

Quick check: Is a grasshopper's development complete or incomplete?

Incomplete.

cards.f: IN·sect
cards.b:
An arthropod with three body parts (head, thorax, abdomen), six legs and usually wings and antennae.

昆虫：身体分头、胸、腹三部分，有六条腿，通常有翅和触角的节肢动物。

🧠 insectum = cut into sections.insectum = 分节的。

Quick check: How many legs does an insect have?

Six.

cards.f: a·RACH·nid
cards.b:
An arthropod with eight legs, two body regions and no antennae, such as a spider or scorpion.

蛛形动物：有八条腿、身体分两部分、没有触角的节肢动物，如蜘蛛和蝎子。

🧠 arachne = spider in Greek.arachne = 蜘蛛。

Quick check: How many legs does a spider have?

Eight.

cards.f: crus·TA·cean
cards.b:
An arthropod with two pairs of antennae and gills, most living in water, such as a crab or shrimp.

甲壳动物：有两对触角和鳃的节肢动物，大多生活在水中，如螃蟹和虾。

🧠 crusta = shell.crusta = 硬壳。

Quick check: Name a crustacean.

A crab, lobster or shrimp.

cards.f: e·CHI·no·derm
cards.b:
A spiny-skinned marine animal with radial symmetry as an adult and a water vascular system, such as a sea star.

棘皮动物：体表有棘、成体辐射对称、有水管系统的海洋动物，如海星。

🧠 echino = spiny, derm = skin.echino = 带刺，derm = 皮。

Quick check: Name an echinoderm.

A sea star, sea urchin or sand dollar.

cards.f: WA·ter VAS·cu·lar SYS·tem
cards.b:
A network of water-filled canals ending in tube feet that echinoderms use to move and feed.

水管系统：充满水的管道网络，末端是管足，棘皮动物用它运动和摄食。

🧠 vascular = tubes.vascular = 管道。

Quick check: What are the tube feet part of?

The water vascular system.

cards.f: CHOR·date
cards.b:
An animal that at some stage has a notochord, dorsal hollow nerve cord, pharyngeal slits and post-anal tail.

脊索动物：在生活史的某个阶段具有脊索、背神经管、咽裂和肛后尾的动物。

🧠 chorda = string.chorda = 弦。

Quick check: Name the four chordate features.

Notochord, dorsal hollow nerve cord, pharyngeal slits and a post-anal tail (at some stage).

cards.f: NO·to·chord
cards.b:
A flexible rod along the back that supports the body of a chordate.

脊索：沿背部延伸、支撑脊索动物身体的柔韧杆状结构。

🧠 noto = back, chord = string.noto = 背，chord = 弦。

Quick check: In vertebrates, what replaces the notochord?

The backbone.

cards.f: DOR·sal HOL·low NERVE CORD
cards.b:
A tube of nerve tissue along the back of a chordate. It becomes the brain and spinal cord.

背神经管：脊索动物背部的神经组织管，会发育成脑和脊髓。

🧠 dorsal = back.dorsal = 背。

Quick check: Is the chordate nerve cord on the back or belly?

The back (dorsal).

cards.f: pha·RYN·ge·al SLITS
cards.b:
Openings in the throat region that become gills in fish.

咽裂：咽部的开口，在鱼类中发育成鳃。

🧠 pharynx = throat.pharynx = 咽。

Quick check: What do pharyngeal slits become in fish?

Gills.

cards.f: FISH
cards.b:
A vertebrate that lives in water, breathes with gills and swims with fins.

鱼类：生活在水中、用鳃呼吸、用鳍游泳的脊椎动物。

🧠 fish: gills + fins.鳃加鳍。

Quick check: How do fish breathe?

With gills.

cards.f: GILL
cards.b:
An organ that takes oxygen from water and releases carbon dioxide.

鳃：从水中吸收氧气并排出二氧化碳的器官。

🧠 gills have many thin folds to give a large surface.鳃有很多薄褶，表面积大。

Quick check: What gas do gills take from the water?

Oxygen.

cards.f: am·PHIB·i·an
cards.b:
A vertebrate that lives partly in water and partly on land, with moist skin and eggs laid in water.

两栖动物：一部分时间生活在水中、一部分在陆地，皮肤湿润、在水中产卵的脊椎动物。

🧠 amphi = both, bios = life. Double life.amphi = 双，bios = 生活：两栖。

Quick check: Name an amphibian.

A frog, toad or salamander.

cards.f: REP·tile
cards.b:
A vertebrate with dry scaly skin that breathes with lungs and lays leathery eggs on land.

爬行动物：皮肤干燥有鳞、用肺呼吸、在陆地产带革质壳的卵的脊椎动物。

🧠 reptum = crawling.reptum = 爬行。

Quick check: Name a reptile.

A snake, lizard, turtle or crocodile.

cards.f: am·ni·OT·ic EGG
cards.b:
An egg with a protective shell and membranes that lets the embryo develop on land.

羊膜卵：有保护性外壳和胚膜、使胚胎能在陆地上发育的卵。

🧠 amnion = the membrane around the embryo.amnion = 包裹胚胎的羊膜。

Quick check: Why did the amniotic egg matter?

It let vertebrates reproduce on land, away from water.

cards.f: BIRD
cards.b:
A vertebrate with feathers and wings that lays hard-shelled eggs and keeps a steady body temperature.

鸟类：有羽毛和翅膀、产硬壳蛋、体温恒定的脊椎动物。

🧠 birds evolved from small feathered dinosaurs.鸟类由小型带羽毛的恐龙演化而来。

Quick check: What covers a bird's body?

Feathers.

cards.f: MAM·mal
cards.b:
A vertebrate with hair or fur that feeds its young milk from mammary glands.

哺乳动物：有毛发、用乳腺分泌的乳汁哺育幼体的脊椎动物。

🧠 mamma = breast.mamma = 乳房。

Quick check: What do mammals feed their young?

Milk.

cards.f: MAM·ma·ry GLAND
cards.b:
A gland in female mammals that makes milk.

乳腺：雌性哺乳动物产生乳汁的腺体。

🧠 mamma = breast.mamma = 乳房。

Quick check: Which group of animals has mammary glands?

Mammals.

cards.f: EC·to·therm
cards.b:
An animal whose body temperature depends on its surroundings, such as a fish, frog or lizard.

变温动物：体温取决于周围环境的动物，如鱼、青蛙和蜥蜴。

🧠 ecto = outside heat.ecto = 外部，therm = 热。

Quick check: Is a lizard an ectotherm?

Yes.

cards.f: EN·do·therm
cards.b:
An animal that makes its own body heat and keeps a steady temperature, such as a bird or mammal.

恒温动物：自己产生热量、保持体温稳定的动物，如鸟类和哺乳动物。

🧠 endo = inside heat.endo = 内部，therm = 热。

Quick check: Are birds ectotherms or endotherms?

Endotherms.

cards.f: pla·CEN·ta
cards.b:
An organ in most mammals that passes nutrients and oxygen from mother to embryo.

胎盘：大多数哺乳动物体内把养分和氧气从母体传给胚胎的器官。

🧠 placenta = Latin for flat cake.placenta 在拉丁语里是「扁饼」。

Quick check: What does the placenta do?

It passes nutrients and oxygen to the embryo and removes wastes.

cards.f: mar·SU·pi·al
cards.b:
A mammal whose young are born tiny and finish developing in the mother's pouch, such as a kangaroo.

有袋类：幼体出生时很小、在母体育儿袋中继续发育的哺乳动物，如袋鼠。

🧠 marsupium = pouch.marsupium = 袋。

Quick check: Name a marsupial.

A kangaroo or koala.

cards.f: MON·o·treme
cards.b:
A mammal that lays eggs, such as the platypus and echidna.

单孔类：产卵的哺乳动物，如鸭嘴兽和针鼹。

🧠 mono = one, trema = opening.mono = 一，trema = 孔。

Quick check: Name a monotreme.

The platypus or the echidna.

quiz.q: Which phylum has stinging cells?
quiz.why: Cnidocytes are the stinging cells.

quiz.q: Which is a mollusk feature?
quiz.why: Snails, clams and squid share them.

quiz.q: Segmented worms with a true coelom are
quiz.why: Annelida means ringed.

quiz.q: Which has an exoskeleton of chitin and jointed legs?
quiz.why: Arthropods molt their exoskeleton.

quiz.q: A spider has
quiz.why: Arachnids have eight legs.

quiz.q: Which life cycle includes a pupa?
quiz.why: Egg, larva, pupa, adult.

quiz.q: A sea star is a(n)
quiz.why: Spiny skin and a water vascular system.

quiz.q: Which feature is NOT one of the chordate features?
quiz.why: Chitin exoskeletons belong to arthropods.

quiz.q: Which vertebrates are endotherms?
quiz.why: They make their own body heat.

quiz.q: An animal with moist skin that lays eggs in water and goes through metamorphosis is
quiz.why: Amphibians.

quiz.q: The amniotic egg is most important because it
quiz.why: Its shell and membranes protect the embryo.

quiz.q: Which group has mammary glands?
quiz.why: Mammary glands make milk.

quiz.q: A kangaroo is a
quiz.why: Young develop in a pouch.

quiz.q: The platypus is a mammal that
quiz.why: It is a monotreme.

quiz.q: Which structure moves in a sea star?
quiz.why: Part of the water vascular system.

quiz.q:
Which term matches this definition?
“An animal that makes its own body heat and keeps a steady temperature, such as a bird or mammal.”
quiz.why: endotherm: An animal that makes its own body heat and keeps a steady temperature, such as a bird or mammal. 恒温动物

quiz.q:
Which term matches this definition?
“An animal that at some stage has a notochord, dorsal hollow nerve cord, pharyngeal slits and post-anal tail.”
quiz.why: chordate: An animal that at some stage has a notochord, dorsal hollow nerve cord, pharyngeal slits and post-anal tail. 脊索动物

quiz.q:
Which term matches this definition?
“An organ in most mammals that passes nutrients and oxygen from mother to embryo.”
quiz.why: placenta: An organ in most mammals that passes nutrients and oxygen from mother to embryo. 胎盘

quiz.q:
Which term matches this definition?
“A network of water-filled canals ending in tube feet that echinoderms use to move and feed.”
quiz.why: water vascular system: A network of water-filled canals ending in tube feet that echinoderms use to move and feed. 水管系统

quiz.q:
Which term matches this definition?
“A cnidarian body form that is tube-shaped and attached, with the mouth and tentacles pointing up.”
quiz.why: polyp: A cnidarian body form that is tube-shaped and attached, with the mouth and tentacles pointing up. 水螅型

quiz.q:
Which term matches this definition?
“A stinging cell on a cnidarian's tentacles that fires a barbed thread at prey.”
quiz.why: cnidocyte: A stinging cell on a cnidarian's tentacles that fires a barbed thread at prey. 刺细胞

quiz.q:
Which term matches this definition?
“An animal with jointed legs, a segmented body and a hard exoskeleton, such as an insect, spider or crab.”
quiz.why: arthropod: An animal with jointed legs, a segmented body and a hard exoskeleton, such as an insect, spider or crab. 节肢动物

quiz.q:
Which term matches this definition?
“A spiny-skinned marine animal with radial symmetry as an adult and a water vascular system, such as a sea star.”
quiz.why: echinoderm: A spiny-skinned marine animal with radial symmetry as an adult and a water vascular system, such as a sea star. 棘皮动物

quiz.q:
Which term matches this definition?
“An animal whose body temperature depends on its surroundings, such as a fish, frog or lizard.”
quiz.why: ectotherm: An animal whose body temperature depends on its surroundings, such as a fish, frog or lizard. 变温动物

quiz.q:
Which term matches this definition?
“Development in four stages: egg, larva, pupa and adult, where the adult looks very different.”
quiz.why: complete metamorphosis: Development in four stages: egg, larva, pupa and adult, where the adult looks very different. 完全变态
